Intro: ^I thought we'd run so far away.
^Turn us back! I don't want to do this anymore!
^We'll give you your money back! Please, let us go!
^Sorry! I'm afraid I can't let the two of you go right now.
^Besides, I have no way of separating you two.
^I have an idea. Why don't you two just accept it?

WhiteRoom_1: ^Who are you? What are you doing here?
^I got injured training for the school track team.
^The doctor said I couldn't run anymore, but I kept trying anyway.
^I ran and fell more times than I can count. It hurt so much. And then I ended up here.
^No. But it's so warm and comfortable here.
^I feel like I could run as fast as flying here.
^Wouldn't it be great if it were like this out there too?
^Who knows. I just hope you come to see the truth soon.
^Follow me and you won't lose a thing.
^All human suffering comes from the helplessness of being unable to do what lies beyond the body.
^In its final stage of evolution, humanity will merge into one, sharing a single mind, with no physical body.
^Then we can never be hurt. We can fly like the wind, travel among the stars, and our possibilities will be endless.
^No more helplessness, no more regret, no more discrimination.
^Then even getting shot wouldn't be scary, would it?
^In short, my mission is to bring that day closer to mankind.
^Would you believe that with just one switch, I could give you that dream life?
AfterLevel3: ^I had a really strange dream just now.
^Did you dream about those things again?

WhiteRoom_2: ^I don't know what I'm supposed to feel. I'm just tired.
^Stop hesitating. Do you want to go back to being that lonely failure?
